comment: TOOLPAGE-A11Y-1 down-only baseline: generated node pages the accessibility chrome cannot fix. A page listed here must still FAIL the gate; a listed page that now fully passes is itself a red (STALE baseline entry, the ratchet only turns downward). Reasons cite the blocking fact measured at gate time.

entries.art-124-content-credential-signature-ver: page-only controls signer_public_key_jwk / signed_bytes_b64 / signature_b64 are the CALLER's own verify material, deliberately outside the v1.1.0 tool contract (the kernel input is the attested signature_verified boolean); they carry explicit aria-labels but sit outside the manifest labeling table by design, so the chrome cannot cover them from the manifest.
